title: Create: Chemistry - Fix
description: A small fix and extension for Create: Chemistry
body:
This is a small mod with some fixes and additional recipes for **Create: Chemistry.**

Requires **[Create](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create)** (v. 6.0.10) and **[Create: Chemistry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-chemistry)** (v. 1.2.0).

# **Mod`s features:**

**1) Craft fixes**

In original version of the mod, recipes of Copper Carbonate (via crushing and milling) don`t work properly. The same issue is with Green Dye recipe. This problem is solved with this mod.

**2) Additional automation**

To make Copper Carbonate more usable, we`ve added some new automation recipes:
Diamond production: 2 obsidian, 2 coal blocks and 2 copper carbonate to make 1 diamond
Amethyst production: 1 amethyst, 1 stone and 1 copper carbonate to produce 3 amethyst
 

**3) Gunpowder recipe**

The result of the most complicated craft of the mod is 1 TNT. To make it more usable, we changed the output of this recipe to 4 gunpowder.

**4) New translation**

We added Russian and Spanish translation to all of the Create: Chemistry contents.

 

This is an unofficial compatibility fix and extension. It is not affiliated with the authors of Create or Create: Chemistry.
